bytes."},{"step":3,"file":"openvswitch/tests/oss-fuzz/ofp_print_target.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":19,"var":"length","code":"size_t length = ntohs(oh->length);","note":"The header length), length, NULL, NULL, 2);","note":"The selected message slice is handed to the OpenFlow printer, which decodes embedded actions from the attacker-controlled payload."},{"step":5,"file":"openvswitch/lib/ofp-print.c","function":"ofp_print_packet_out","line":148,"var":"po.ofpacts","code":"error = ofputil_decode_packet_out(&po, oh, NULL, decoder."},{"step":6,"file":"openvswitch/lib/ofp-actions.c","function":"ofpacts_decode","line":7466,"var":"actions/actions_len","code":"error = ofpact_pull_raw(&openflow, ofp_version, &raw, &arg);","note":"The raw action header is parsed from attacker-controlled action bytes and used to select the concrete action decoder."},{"step":7,"file":"openvswitch/lib/ofp-actions.c","function":"ofpact_decode","line":7480,"var":"action","code":"error = ofpact_decode(action, raw, ofp_version, arg, vl_mff_map, ofpacts_tlv_bitmap, ofpacts);","note":"The selected raw action is dispatched to the Nicira extension decoder for NXAST_ENCAP."},{"step":8,"file":"openvswitch/lib/ofp-actions.c","function":"decode_NXAST_RAW_ENCAP","line":4319,"var":"nae->len / nae->props","code":"props_len = ntohs(nae->len) - offsetof(struct nx_action_encap, props); while (props_len > 0) { err = decode_ed_prop(&ofp_prop, out, &props_len); }","note":"The encap action length controls how many property TLVs are decoded from attacker data; malformed TLVs can drive the decoder into a use-after-free path."},{"step":9,"file":"openvswitch/lib/ofp-actions.c","function":"decode_NXAST_RAW_ENCAP","line":4354,"var":"encap/out","code":"ofpact_finish_ENCAP(out, &encap);","note":"The decoder finalizes the encap action after property parsing, but the vulnerable path has already corrupted lifetime/ownership of the action buffer."}]
JSON
